summary_en: A cooking tutorial video captures the preparation of ingredients, chopping of vegetables and salmon, blending chickpea sauce using an immersion blender, mixing batter, and frying pancakes on a stove. Finally, the chef decorates the layered pancakes with cream, fruits, and flowers to complete the dish.
